chartXSelection(value:) is a generic Chart method: func chartXSelection

(value: Binding) -> some View where P: Plottable. String conforms to Plottable, so chartXSelection(value: Binding) is valid and works against a categorical/nominal x-axis (band scale) exactly like the existing key(for:) String keys in AlcoholAreaChart/WeekdayBarChart. Available since iOS 17, well below the project's iOS 26 minimum deployment.
